relationships.summary: Chief Lian Okafor welcomed Jeremy aboard in Transporter Room 2. Jeremy thanked the chief and expressed enthusiasm for the posting.

Brel Joras introduced himself as a transporter-systems crewman on his first posting aboard Asteria. He accompanied Jeremy to the doorway of quarters 0712-C. Jeremy shared his DS 2 upbringing and interest in exploration. They said goodbye at the quarters and agreed to see each other at orientation.
